# requires: store
#
# A listener that took nothing while several changes landed gets one notice
# carrying the latest. The quiet after it is the proof: a backlog would have
# been a second change.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=file
watch W 300
next W
claim A alpha 60000
progress A alpha 10
progress A alpha 20
finish A alpha complete
next W
next W

# expect 8: changed [WATCH-C1]
# expect 8: A=complete/20
# expect 9: quiet [WATCH-C1]
